title: Can foundation models actively gather information in interactive environments to test hypotheses?

live_model.evidence: 'Gemini...Claude 3.7 Sonnet...ChatGPT-4o and o4-mini'; efficiency = 'success rate in finding a rewarding object within a fixed step budget'

prompt.location: Method describes 'in-context prompting alone' with variations in prior information and demonstration structure; exact prompt templates not confirmed located in the excerpt read

claim.metric: none confirmed with a specific numeric value for o4-mini in the excerpt read (results are given as figures, e.g. Figure 5a/5b/6c, rather than in-text numbers)

data.source: Feature World (text-based Alchemy variant) and Alchemy (Wang et al., 2021), both public interactive RL environments

notes: A genuinely public, code-available pair of interactive environments and a live-listed model (o4-mini), but no specific reproducible number for o4-mini could be pinned down from in-text values (results are reported via multi-panel figures); a follow-up PDF/figure-data check could plausibly upgrade this to maybe or eligible.
